name: craft-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the creative-build studio in one install — concept-first creative direction with a tiered motion catalog (craft-layer), visual decisions rendered with the project's own components (design-preview), a shadcn staging sandbox (shadcn-studio), live component-registry MCP sourcing (registry-source), and WebGL/Three.js effects (threejs), plus the two companions the studio requires: ui-ux and a11y. Split out of frontend-suite so ordinary frontend app work does not pay the studio's always-on context. Uninstall cleanly with /craft-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins.
